app_tagline: GramSetu: Digital Bridge for Farmers - Crop Doctor, Outbreak Warnings & Mandi Rates

home.hero_subtitle: Take a photo of sick crops for instant AI diagnosis, get village-level early disease warnings, and discover the best Mandi selling prices.

crop_doctor.title: Crop Doctor
crop_doctor.subtitle: Take a clear picture of the infected plant leaf or choose from gallery. You can also describe symptoms using your voice.
crop_doctor.voice_label: Speak symptoms (e.g., yellow spots on leaves)
crop_doctor.analyzing: AI Doctor is diagnosing your crop... Please wait 2-3 seconds
crop_doctor.disclaimer: This information is for guidance only. Confirm with your local agriculture officer or KVK before applying treatments.
crop_doctor.healthy_crop: Your crop is completely healthy and thriving!

outbreaks.title: Village-Level Outbreak Early Warning Map
outbreaks.subtitle: Interactive map clustering crop diseases reported by local farmers. Automated alert triggered when 3+ farmers report.
outbreaks.alert_title: ⚠️ Crop Disease Warning in Your Vicinity!
outbreaks.alert_subtitle: Reports of crop infection detected within 10 km of your village. Please inspect your field immediately.
outbreaks.disclaimer: Outbreak alerts are community-sourced early warnings, not official state confirmations.

mandi.title: Mandi Rates & Sell Helper
mandi.subtitle: Live market rates from agricultural mandis in your district and surroundings, plus revenue calculation helper.
mandi.sample_data_note: Sample Data - Displayed because government data servers are temporarily unavailable.
mandi.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a guarantee. Final mandi price depends on crop grade and moisture.
